response.overview: Megasonix fights to rescue his friend Mega Félix from a dimension of Exes. On his multiversal journey, he discovers that his amnesia and destiny are being manipulated by the Lord of Reincarnation. The story is a cycle of sacrifice and vengeance in which the protagonist must decide whether to break the tragic loop or continue losing his essence in the process.
response.title: the MegaSonic multiverse
